title: The Frequency design system installs from its Claude Design export in one command and switches on locally with another

source.ref: ADR-1740. Owner 2026-10-13: install the Frequency theme locally, switch it over manually and see what breaks; make the system and framework ready for the design system.

detail:
pnpm design:install <export.zip> vendors the export's locked core to design_handoff/frequency/, generates app/themes/frequency/core.css (every property renamed --fq-, every selector scoped to [data-design="frequency"]: Commons on the root, Commons-at-night on .dark, Stage on [data-surface="stage"], element defaults in @layer base) and copies the marks to public/brand/frequency/. app/themes/frequency.css is the hand-kept alias layer pointing --color-*, the radius roles and the --design-* layer at --fq- tokens, declared on the root and on every Stage surface. lib/theme/design-fonts/frequency.ts registers Unbounded, Instrument Serif and Hanken Grotesk. The marketing layout and home are Stage surfaces. pnpm design:use frequency|dawn writes the one .env.local line and rewrites the font module and manifest colours. Measured locally: under frequency /pricing renders Stage (#0A0612, cards #140B22, magenta actions, Unbounded headings, Hanken body); under dawn it is unchanged.

Shipped 2026-10-13 against the 'Frequency Design System.zip' export.
